svg.aria-label: What a vendor sees inside xv on Linux: codex and agy run in one bubblewrap (bwrap) layout with the whole filesystem read-only. Hidden: /run (docker.sock, D-Bus, systemd --user), the X11 and default tmux socket directories, credential files other than its own login, such as ~/.ssh, ~/.aws and .env files, and environment variables named like key, token or secret are not passed in. Writable: the vendor's own state directory with its config entries kept read-only and agy's bin/ replaced by a per-round copy, a per-round TMPDIR deleted afterwards, and with --write DIR only one linked worktree whose .git pointer and gitdir stay read-only. The vendor runs in its own pid namespace, so background processes die with the round; codex also keeps its own -s read-only sandbox.
svg.text: xv on Linux: codex and agy run in one bubblewrap (bwrap) layout
(blanked; the vendor keeps its own login)
agy bin/ = throwaway copy per round
own pid namespace (--unshare-pid): background processes die with the round
codex also keeps its own sandbox: -s read-only (workspace-write with --write)
